Vacancies over two years run 188 against 149 (Dickey, North Dakota, seed n8g7), 177 against 158 (seed n8b2) and 177 against 155 (seed k3q9): 12 to 26 percent more. A monthly place-and-age outcome-web factor for husks changed no count, so the gap is the person model's income side (the opening ranks conditions and the income fifth by household income; a husk has no household).

replacement: A husk's income fifth is read from the seat's pay (data/research/offices/official-salaries-2026.json) and given to its conditions and its web factor, the way a person's household income is.
